name: Allos
event_blurb: Allos is an AI-native specialty CDMO that builds differentiated 505(b)(2) products and NCE FDFs, using a causal-AI engine to originate, kill, and de-risk candidates at a fraction of the usual cost and time. The team pairs Oxford, CERN, and Utrecht physicists in causal inference with 40-plus years of formulation, CDMO, and vaccine-manufacturing leadership to take formulations including DPIs, nasal sprays, oral liquids, long-acting depots and first-to-US sterile products from idea to filing.

name: Axplora
event_blurb:
Axplora is a leading European CDMO, with five industrial sites dedicated to the development and manufacturing of APIs and ADCs, from early process development to commercial scale.
With 30+ years of expertise in advanced technologies such as chromatography, energetic chemistry and electrochemistry, Axplora tackles the most demanding challenges and helps you navigate the complexities of API and ADC development.
Axplora invested >100M€ across its sites in 2025 to strengthen its capabilities & reinforce its position at the forefront of pharmaceutical manufacturing worldwide.
When science dares to imagine, Axplora makes it real, at scale, with precision and speed.

name: Boryung
event_blurb:
Boryung: A Trusted Partner for Specialized Drug Product Manufacturing
Boryung is a pharmaceutical company with a longstanding commitment to delivering essential medicines and ensuring reliable access to critical therapies. Built on decades of manufacturing experience and a strong quality culture, Boryung is expanding its Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO) services to support global pharmaceutical and biotechnology partners.
Our expertise spans the development and manufacturing of specialized drug products, including cytotoxic formulations that require rigorous containment, operational excellence, and strict quality control. Through dedicated manufacturing capabilities and robust quality systems, we help partners navigate the challenges associated with complex pharmaceutical products while maintaining the highest standards of safety, compliance, and supply reliabil
sheet_notes: Pharma company offering drug product CDMO (cytotoxics/essential drugs)

name: CatSci
event_blurb: CatSci is an integrated CMC development partner for complex small molecules and synthetic modalities, combining deep scientific expertise with small-scale GMP manufacturing to deliver robust processes that enable confident scale-up, tech transfer and faster clinical progress

name: Curia Global
event_blurb: Curia (fka AMRI) is a global CDMO with over 30 years of experience successfully guiding clients through the complexities of drug discovery, development, and manufacturing. We offer services across Small Molecule, Generic APIs, Sterile Drug Product and Biologics backed by deep scientific expertise and a robust global network of resources and capabilities. Our dedicated teams enable us to be both flexible and scalable, accelerating the delivery of your product to patients.

name: Fisiopharma S.r.l.
event_blurb: FIS is a top 5 global CDMO for small molecule Drug Substance, with over 70 years of experience in tech transfer, process optimization, scale up, and validation. Our 25+ scientist industrialization team is backed by three closely-clustered Italian sites and dedicated early- and late-phase R&D, with a high ratio of analysts to chemists and 99% of testing conducted in-house. We bring deep expertise in spray drying, flow chemistry, and liquid phase peptide synthesis. Backed by Bain Capital, FIS continues to invest in capacity and technology to support partners from development through commercial scale.

name: Grifols
event_blurb: We are a contract development and manufacturing organization (CDMO) specialized in added value injectable products (small molecules). With extensive global experience, we develop and manufacture various sterile drug products, primarily in flexible bags and vials. Our strength lies in delivering substantial value to our partners.

name: Kimball Solutions
event_blurb:
Kimball Medical Solutions is a single-source partner for medical contract manufacturing.
Our approach to innovation is collaborative and multifaceted enabling speed to market through the complete lifecycle utilizing our expertise in medical electronics, scientific injection molded plastics, and complete medical system assembly.
sheet_notes: Medical-device contract manufacturing (device CMO; not drug CDMO) - judgment call

name: Malta Development Labs
event_blurb: Malta Development Labs is a boutique CDMO specialized in the Development of Highly Potent aseptic filled sterile products. Our team can service all the needs of the Client in order to see their Projects becoming a success. We pay attention to the Client, Listen to their needs and go beyond their expectations. Recently aquired by Mubadala Bio, soon to change the name to MDL - Malta Development Labs, the purpose of the Company is to become one of the core centers of excellence in the EU for Highly Potent injectable medicines.

name: PI Health Sciences Ltd.
event_blurb: PI Health Sciences is a global pharmaceutical CRDMO providing integrated drug discovery, development, analytical, process R&D, clinical supply, and commercial manufacturing services to pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies. Its capabilities span discovery chemistry and biology, DMPK, preclinical services, process development, analytical development, flow chemistry, biocatalysis, and API/HPAPI manufacturing. The company operates across India and Italy, supporting clients from early-stage research through clinical and commercial supply

name: Recipharm
event_blurb: Recipharm is a leading contract development and manufacturing organisation (CDMO) headquartered in Stockholm, Sweden. We operate development and manufacturing facilities in France, Germany, India, Italy, Portugal, Spain, Sweden and the US and are continuing to grow and expand our offering for our customers. We are supporting pharmaceutical companies with our full service offering, taking products from early development through to commercial production. For over 30 years, we have partnered with our clients throughout the entire product lifecycle, providing pharmaceutical expertise and managing complexity, time and time again. We conduct our business as we always have and continue to deliver value for money with each customer’s needs firmly at the heart of all that we do.

name: Suanfarma CDMO
event_blurb:
Suanfarma CDMO - Your European Partner for Small Molecule Innovation
Suanfarma CDMO is a European Contract Development & Manufacturing Organization specializing in the development, scale-up and commercial manufacturing of small molecule APIs and advanced intermediates. We provide integrated solutions from early development through GMP manufacturing and commercial supply, supporting pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies with customized, science-driven partnerships.
Our unique strength lies in combining advanced chemical synthesis, industrial bioconversion (fermentation), and flow chemistry expertise within a single development platform. This enables us to design efficient, scalable and sustainable manufacturing routes for complex molecules while accelerating technology transfer and reducing development risk.

name: Upperton Pharma Solutions
event_blurb: Upperton Pharma Solutions is a UK-based leading contract development and manufacturing organisation (CDMO) specialising in formulation development, clinical trial manufacturing and manufacturing services for a wide range of dosage forms, including oral solids, liquids, semi-solids, and inhalation products. With state-of-the-art facilities and a team of experienced scientists, Upperton offers tailored solutions to accelerate drug development from concept to commercialisation. A King’s Award For Enterprise winner, Upperton is committed to innovation, and quality, and share in our customers’ dedication to changing patients' lives. Upperton collaborates closely with global pharmaceutical and biotech companies to bring novel therapies to market efficiently and effectively.
